claims: Rory McIlroy is the 2026 Masters champion.
The 2026 Masters champion will receive $4.5 million.
The total purse of the 2026 Masters is $22.5 million.
$4.5 million is the highest payout in Masters history.
The 2026 Masters champion's share increased by $300,000 from the 2025 payout.
Scottie Scheffler is the runner-up in the 2026 Masters.
The runner-up in the 2026 Masters will earn $2.43 million.
Third place in the 2026 Masters receives $1.08 million.
Professionals who missed the cut in the 2026 Masters receive $25,000.
The Masters is played at Augusta National Golf Club.
The Masters has the largest prize pool among golf's four major championships.
